Package edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar

Class ToolBits

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar.ToolBits
public final class ToolBits extends Object
Bit flags controlling which pre-defined buttons appear on a BaseToolBar.

Values are written in octal.

Stable IDs

Each predefined bit maps to a stable string id via getId(long). These ids are intended for programmatic lookup through AToolBar.getButton(String) and related methods: 


 toolbar.setButtonEnabled(ToolBits.getId(ToolBits.DELETEBUTTON), hasSelection);

Applications may add their own buttons with their own ids.

  • Method Details

    • getId

      public static String getId(long buttonBit)
      Return a stable string id for a predefined toolbar bit.

      These ids are intended for programmatic lookup through AToolBar.getButton(String) and related methods.

      For application-defined buttons, choose your own ids (e.g., "myCustomTool").

      Parameters:
      buttonBit - a predefined bit constant such as POINTER.
      Returns:
      a stable id string (never null). Unknown bits map to "bit_<value>".

    • getIconRelativePath

      public static String getIconRelativePath(long buttonBit)
      Get the icon path relative to the MDI resource root for a predefined button.
      Parameters:
      buttonBit - the button bit flag.
      Returns:
      relative icon path, or null if no icon is defined for this bit.

    • getResourcePath

      public static String getResourcePath(long buttonBit)
      Get the full resource path for the icon corresponding to the given button bit.

      If the button has no icon (e.g. STATUS), this method returns null.

      Parameters:
      buttonBit - the button bit flag.
      Returns:
      full resource path, or null if no icon is defined.

    • getToolTip

      public static String getToolTip(long buttonBit)
      Get the tooltip string for a predefined button bit.
      Parameters:
      buttonBit - the button bit flag.
      Returns:
      tooltip string, or null if none is defined.
